observations: Photo 0 shows a SHARP copier/printer with model text visible: “SHARP AR-M207”.
Photos 0–2 show the machine wrapped in plastic; control panel/ports/cables and any display are not clearly visible.
No clear photo of the paper tray, output tray, toner/drum compartment, or any printed test page.
No visible serial number/sticker, and no visible counter/page count.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of origin/location; only the seller’s text.

claims.claim: The AR-M207 is packed with an extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: No menu/screens/spec sheet shown in photos.
No counter/page meter photo is provided.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No close-up of drum/toner installation or part labels; machine is wrapped so compartments aren’t visible.
No proof via a test print/copy showing successful feeding and no jam.

risks.risk: Actual page count may be higher than claimed (counter not shown).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s page counter/total prints screen (or service menu counter) with the model visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher-wear used unit (worst case vs the claim).

risks.risk: Whether the drum/toner are truly new and compatible (could be old/low quality or not properly seated).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the toner/drum area with the covers opened, plus a photo of the installed consumable labels/part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed fresh consumables (worst case: treat as used/unknown condition).

risks.risk: Paper feed/jam issues may exist (seller says none, but no test).
risks.proof: Video or photos of a full test: load paper, run multiple copies (e.g., 20–50), show no jam and clean output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may require troubleshooting (worst case: treat as not proven jam-free).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts or connectivity issues (power cable, USB/network, trays).
risks.proof: Photos of included items (power cable, any network/USB accessories) and a shot of all trays/ports; confirm network/USB works with a print.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal accessories and functionality not proven.

risks.risk: Potential hidden faults (fuser/rollers/scanner) not visible while wrapped.
risks.proof: A test copy and (if available) scan to phone/email, plus a photo of the output quality (no streaks/ghosting).
risks.if_unproven: Price as fully untested beyond appearance (worst case: treat as needs verification).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the page counter/total prints screen (showing the AR-M207).
Open the front/toner/drum area and take close-up photos of the installed drum/toner labels/part numbers.
Run a test: print/copy a small batch (e.g., 20–50 pages) and provide a short video showing no jam and consistent output.
Photos of all trays/ports and what accessories are included (power cable, network/USB if any).
A sample output photo showing print quality (no streaks, banding, or ghosting).
response.reason: The model (SHARP AR-M207) is readable from the photos, but the key value drivers—page count, fresh drum/toner, and jam-free operation—are only claimed in text with no counter or test output shown. Without those proofs, pricing would be guesswork.
